findings: Smalltrotter walk-cycle native playback and local pose change are proven on this host. Screenshots are feasibility evidence, not visual acceptance or target-hardware performance.
The lifecycle persistence header in this checkout was copied by the dispatcher for the final integration build; its source ownership remains with the lifecycle-save task.
Host startup deliberately requires a current live hero from a loaded snapshot, so a post-death save is recorded but cannot be relaunched through this diagnostic host.
assumptions_made: Legacy saves without explicit lifecycle restore from the same retained-hero species when available; otherwise Smalltrotter is the age-zero fallback, following the dispatcher-supplied final persistence helper.
The supplied provisional sole offset is applied at the motion parent; this does not establish tail clearance or actual foot planting.
